title: Bright sweater portrait: you in bold colour with glowing eyes
summary: A clean studio portrait of you in a chunky, brightly coloured sweater, on a matching backdrop, with a soft glow in your eyes.
why: Virlo's trend page, updated November 22, 2026, lists the "AI colored sweater photo" as a fresh TikTok format with 47 creators posting it in the last 7 days, up from 1 the week before. Creators use AI to make a portrait in a colourful sweater with glowing eyes, often as a how-to. Our other sweater-weather packs are holiday scenes; this one is a bold, single-colour studio look.
steps: Pick a clear photo of your face and shoulders, looking at the camera.
Choose one colour you love. The look works best when sweater and backdrop match.
Paste the main prompt into your image tool with your photo, adding your colour.
Post it and say it's made with AI.

prompts.label: Main prompt: one bold colour
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo. Keep their face, skin, hair and features exactly the same. Dress them in a chunky, oversized cable-knit sweater in bright [colour]. Place them in front of a smooth studio backdrop in a slightly deeper shade of the same colour. Head-and-shoulders portrait, vertical 4:5, soft front light and a gentle rim light on the hair. Give their eyes a soft, even glow in a lighter tint of [colour], like light shining from inside, while keeping the eye shape and expression natural. Crisp knit texture, calm confident look. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: colour-block pair
prompts.text: Use the two people in this photo, who both agreed to this. Keep both faces and features exactly the same. Put one in a bright [colour 1] chunky knit sweater and the other in bright [colour 2]. Stand them shoulder to shoulder in front of a backdrop split down the middle: [colour 1] behind the first person, [colour 2] behind the second. Soft studio light. Give each person's eyes a gentle glow that matches their sweater. Vertical 4:5. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: winter warm-up
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo and keep their face the same. Dress them in a thick, cosy knit sweater in deep cranberry red with a high rolled neck. Backdrop in the same red, with a few soft white snowflakes drifting out of focus in front of the lens. Warm studio light. Their eyes glow softly in pale gold. Head-and-shoulders, vertical 4:5. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: product colour match
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo of me [upload] and keep my face the same. Dress me in a chunky knit sweater that matches the main colour of [your product]. Use a backdrop in the same colour, and have me hold [your product] near my chest so it's easy to see. Soft studio light, eyes with a gentle glow in a lighter tint of that colour. Vertical 4:5. Keep the product's real shape and colours. No other logos or brand names.

tips: Keep the glow soft. If the eyes look scary, add "subtle" and reroll.
One colour for sweater and backdrop gives the cleanest look. Try a few and post them as a carousel.
If your face changes, say "keep the face exactly the same" again in a follow-up message.
Say it's made with AI, and only use photos of people who agreed.
